statement: The T032 candidate **shall** satisfy the deterministic Phase 7 gate: the five plan work products and the implementation record exist; at least one `tests/` path changes; the Phase 7 runner's unit configure/build and `t032-`-labelled discovery pass; `git diff --check` is clean; and the T032 checkbox is marked complete **only** in the implementation stage.
title: T032 requirement 019
